versions.changelog: v1.3.0 - adds scripts/compare-runs.sh, side-by-side comparison of two self-improvement runs. Reads key fields from each run's run-info.md, baseline.md, proposal.md, validation.md, and outcome.md, prints a row-per-field table that flags divergences with a '*' marker, computes an aggregate verdict (identical/diverged) and an outcome_progression (same/improved/regressed/changed/n/a) so CI can branch on whether the second iteration actually improved on the first. Supports --json for dashboards. Exit 0 identical, 1 diverged, 2 on argument errors or missing artifacts. 9 end-to-end tests cover divergence detection, identical-run case, JSON shape, progression direction (improved/regressed/same), missing args, non-existent dir, partial-artifact dir, --help. No breaking changes - every v1.2.0 CLI flag and contract preserved.

v1.2.0 — adds two new helpers: scripts/list-runs.sh enumerates every self-improvement run under <repo>/.openclaw-self-improve newest first with mode/baseline/validation/outcome status and a one-line objective per row, supports --filter-mode --filter-status --limit and --json, exits 3 on no matching runs so scripts can branch; scripts/summarize-run.sh prints a one-page status overview of a single run by extracting key fields from all six artifacts and computes an overall verdict (success/regression/blocked/inconclusive/incomplete). Bug fixes: init-improvement-run.sh now rejects empty or whitespace-only --objective with exit 1 (was silent footgun, baked TODO placeholder into run); detect-validation-gate.sh now exits 3 with stderr message on no detectable build system instead of silent empty output, init-improvement-run.sh handles new exit code gracefully and falls back to TODO with notice; summarize-run.sh field extraction uses index() instead of regex match so keys with parentheses like 'Timestamp (UTC)' are read correctly. No breaking changes — all v1.1.0 CLI flags, output filenames, and contracts unchanged.

v1.1.0 — Bug-fix and quality release.

Critical fixes:
- BUG: Fresh runs failed validation immediately. init wrote literal placeholder "pass|fail|blocked|inconclusive" as the status bullet, which the validator rejected. Now defaults to "inconclusive" so the workflow is usable end-to-end.
- BUG: backup-repo.sh crashed with "local: can only be used in a function" (line 111). Rewritten to build the zip command as an array, no eval, no in-script local outside functions.
- BUG: --rollback silently ran "git checkout ." on the entire repo when called with a non-existent or empty run directory, accidentally reverting unrelated work. Now refuses to run without a real run dir AND a defined target list (from --scope or proposal.md "Files To Edit").
- BUG: Unicode objectives (Hindi, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, etc.) were stripped to empty by overly aggressive sed sanitizers. New sanitize_oneline only removes newlines and backticks; preserves all UTF-8 text.
- BUG: --auto-detect-validation silently overrode --validation-gate when both passed. Explicit gate now wins with a clear stderr notice.
- BUG: detect-validation-gate.sh dedup loop tripped "set -u" on empty arrays in some bash versions. Rewritten with explicit existence checks.
- BUG: logging-utils.sh log_command used eval on its argument (shell-injection risk). Rewritten to use direct argv expansion.

New features:
- set-status.sh helper to mark baseline / validation / outcome / proposal status without hand-editing markdown. Validates the status value before writing.
- export-improvement-run-json.py --strict flag exits non-zero when statuses or hypothesis text are still placeholders, so CI does not silently accept incomplete runs.
- detect-validation-gate.sh now picks pnpm/yarn/npm based on lockfile presence, prefers ./gradlew over gradle when present, and only emits a default test command when one is actually detected.
- LICENSE file shipped with the skill.
- README and SKILL.md rewritten with Quick Start that walks through the full lifecycle including set-status calls.

Improvements:
- All bash scripts use safe argument handling — no eval, no shell=True equivalent, no implicit string-joined arrays.
- Validator now accepts both "- " and "* " bullet markers under status sections.
- Cleaner error messages on every failure path.
- Test coverage of every fix was verified end-to-end before publishing.
Added logging system, validation gate auto-detection, backup mechanism for non-git repos, improved documentation with playbooks and output contract references.
Fixed suspicious flag by adding input sanitization and added a new rollback feature.

v1.0.6: Added required_binaries metadata, detailed init template placeholders, Examples section with 3 use cases, path-agnostic Quick Start, Git Commit/Branch auto-fill in run-info.md, post-scaffold verification in checklists, README.md, refined description, graceful fallbacks in export script, cleaner error messages in validate script
Add optional CI-style JSON enforcement to run validation and align docs/metadata for automation-ready outputs
Add machine-readable JSON export, playbook-guided workflow docs, and artifact validation improvements
Add dry-run and force-safe scaffold options, stricter normalization, status fields, and contract alignment
Fix scaffold collisions, add mode/objective parameters, auto-capture git state, and tighten workflow docs/contracts
Add structured modes, checklists, output contract, and run scaffolding script
